example.title: Apartment building at 1012 3rd Street
example.place: Santa Monica, Los Angeles County, CA

brief: A 1970s four-storey apartment block: white stucco with stacked recessed balconies behind white rails crowded with plants, a flat roof with a rooftop rail, steps up from the sidewalk and a garage entry at the side. One photo. Scaled to the lot. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
